app.name: TikTok
app.description: Users view and explore clips, broadcast in real time, and browse products from merchants. The service delivers a customized viewing stream, simple production utilities, audio and visual enhancements, and numerous preset security settings.

verdict.one_liner: TikTok collects extensive data about your activity, location, contacts, and device, and states that it shares it with advertisers and business partners for personalized ads.
verdict.summary: TikTok collects a wide range of data including account details, content you upload, messages, clipboard, contacts, purchases, and identity documents. It automatically collects usage behavior, inferred interests, gender, age range, device identifiers, IP address, and location. It uses cookies and web beacons to track browsing. Data is shared with business partners, service providers, advertisers, affiliates, researchers, sellers, and law enforcement when required. Users can access, delete, update, or rectify data through the privacy portal. Data is retained as long as necessary for the platform plus legal and safety needs.
verdict.recommendation_reason: TikTok collects extensive personal data and shares it widely with advertisers and partners. While you can delete your account, the app's broad data collection and sharing practices pose significant privacy risks.

red.title: Infers your interests, gender, and age range
red.plain_english: TikTok states that it infers your attributes, including your interests, gender, and age range, for the purpose of personalising content.

red.title: Shares data with advertisers and business partners
red.plain_english: TikTok explicitly states that it shares your information with advertisers, advertising partners, publishers, and third-party measurement companies.

red.title: Tracks your activity across devices
red.plain_english: TikTok explicitly states that it uses your device IDs and user ID to identify your activity across devices, and may associate you with information from devices other than those you use to log in.

red.title: Analyzes objects and faces in your videos
red.plain_english: TikTok states that it may collect information about the videos, images, and audio in your User Content, such as identifying objects, scenery, face and body features, and the text of spoken words.

red.title: Keeps your data for broad purposes
red.plain_english: TikTok states that it retains your information for as long as necessary to provide the Platform and for other purposes set out in the privacy policy, including legal, safety, and business interests.

green.title: You can delete your account
green.plain_english: TikTok states that you may delete your entire account in Settings.

green.title: Privacy controls available
green.plain_english: TikTok states that it provides tools in Settings to control who can view your videos, send you messages, or post comments.

green.title: Data rights request portal
green.plain_english: TikTok states that you may submit a request to exercise your data rights, such as access, deletion, update, or rectification, through its privacy portal.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: TikTok accesses your camera and microphone when you create or upload photos, videos, or livestreams. It states that it may analyze the objects, scenery, and audio in your content.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone are used for creating and uploading content. The policy states that TikTok may analyze objects, scenery, face and body features, and spoken words in uploaded content for effects, moderation, and recommendations.
categories.policy_excerpt: We process the content you generate on the Platform, including photographs, audios and videos you upload or create... We may collect information about the videos, images and audio that are a part of your User Content, such as identifying the objects and scenery that appear.
concerns: Visual and audio content analyzed automatically

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it collects your approximate location automatically using your SIM card and IP address. With your permission, it may also collect precise GPS location.
categories.detail: Approximate location is inferred from SIM card and IP address without requiring explicit permission. Precise GPS is collected only with permission. Location is used for personalized content and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about your approximate location, including location information based on your SIM card and/or IP address. With your permission, we may also collect precise location data (such as GPS).

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that if you choose to sync your phone contacts, it will access and collect names, phone numbers, and email addresses to match against existing users.
categories.detail: Contact sync is optional. If enabled, TikTok accesses and collects names, phone numbers, and email addresses from your phone and social network contacts to find existing users.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to sync your phone contacts, we will access and collect information such as names, phone numbers, and email addresses, and match that information against existing users of the Platform.
concerns: Contacts collected and matched against user database

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: TikTok processes the photos, videos, and audio that you upload or create. It states that it may pre-load content during creation or import, even if you do not choose to save or upload it.
categories.detail: User Content is collected through pre-loading at creation, import, or upload regardless of whether you save or upload it. Clipboard access requires permission.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect User Content through pre-loading at the time of creation, import, or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or upload that User Content
concerns: Content pre-loaded before you choose to save or upload

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it shares your information with business partners, service providers, advertisers, advertising networks, its corporate group, independent researchers, and law enforcement when legally required. It also states that your information may be transferred in a sale or merger.
categories.detail: Data is shared with advertisers, business partners, service providers, corporate affiliates, independent researchers, and law enforcement. Mergers and acquisitions may result in data transfers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share your information with the following parties: Business Partners... Service Providers... Advertisers, Advertising Networks, Publishers, and Measurement Partners... Our Corporate Group... We may also disclose your information to third parties: in the event that we sell or buy any business or assets... if we sell, buy, merge, are acquired by, or partner with other companies or businesses.
concerns: Shared with law enforcement when required

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok collects your username, email, phone number, date of birth, and profile photo or video when you register. It states that it may sometimes ask for proof of identity or age for certain features.
categories.detail: Registration requires username, email or phone, date of birth, and profile media. Proof of identity or age may be requested for livestream, verified accounts, or business accounts.
categories.policy_excerpt: You give us information when you register on the Platform, including your username, password, date of birth (where applicable), email address and/or telephone number, information you disclose in your user account, and your photograph or profile video... We sometimes ask you to provide proof of identity or age in order to use certain features
concerns: Identity documents may be requested for some features

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it collects information about how you use the Platform, including videos you watch, ads you view, your browsing and search history, and what content you like. It says it uses this to deliver personalized advertising on and off the Platform, and may infer your interests, gender, and age range.
categories.detail: Usage data including viewed ads, watched videos, browsing history, and liked content is collected continuously. Cookies and web beacons are used for tracking on and off the Platform. Inferences about interests, gender, and age are drawn for personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information regarding your use of the Platform, e.g., how you engage with the Platform, including how you interact with content we show to you, the advertisements you view, videos you watch and problems encountered, browsing and search history, the content you like... We also infer your attributes, including your interests, gender and age range for the purpose of personalising content.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it is not directed at children under 13, or under 16 in some regions. It does not describe how it verifies age.
categories.detail: The policy states the platform is not directed at children under 13 (or 16 in some jurisdictions like Australia). No age verification mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: TikTok is not directed at children under the age of 13. In certain cases this age may be higher due to local regulatory requirements

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: TikTok collects your IP address, user agent, and mobile carrier automatically. It states that it uses your IP address and SIM card information to determine your approximate location.
categories.detail: IP address, user agent, mobile carrier, and other device data are collected automatically. IP and SIM data are used for approximate location inference.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect certain information about the device you use to access the Platform, such as your IP address, user agent, mobile carrier... We collect information about your approximate location, including location information based on your SIM card and/or IP address.
concerns: IP used for approximate location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it collects device information including advertising identifiers, device IDs, and user IDs. It explicitly states that it uses these identifiers to identify your activity across multiple devices, and may associate you with information from devices other than those you use to log in.
categories.detail: Advertising identifiers, device IDs, and user IDs are collected. Cross-device tracking is explicitly described, including association with devices you do not use to log in.
categories.policy_excerpt: We automatically assign user IDs and device IDs. Where you log-in from multiple devices, we use your information such as your device IDs and user ID to identify your activity across devices. We may also associate you with information collected from devices other than those you use to log-in to the Platform.
concerns: Association with devices you do not use to log in

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it analyzes face and body features in your uploaded videos and images for special effects, content moderation, and demographic classification. It does not claim to collect or store separate biometric health data.
categories.detail: Face and body feature analysis occurs in uploaded content for effects, moderation, and demographic classification. No separate biometric health data collection is claimed.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect information about the videos, images and audio that are a part of your User Content, such as identifying the objects and scenery that appear, the existence and location within an image of face and body features and attributes
concerns: Face and body feature analysis in uploaded content

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that it collects payment card information, billing details, and delivery information when you make purchases on the Platform, such as buying TikTok Coins or goods through shopping features.
categories.detail: Payment card info, billing, delivery, and contact details are collected for purchases. This includes TikTok Coins and shopping transactions.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you make a purchase or payment on or through the Platform, including when you buy TikTok Coins or purchase goods through our shopping features, we collect information about the purchase or payment transaction, such as payment card information, billing, delivery, and contact information, and items you purchased.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that you may delete your account and uploaded content through Settings. It also states that it retains information as long as necessary to provide the Platform and for legal, safety, and business purposes.
categories.detail: Account and content deletion are available. Retention is broad: kept as long as necessary for platform operation, legal obligations, safety, and legitimate business interests.
categories.policy_excerpt: Should you choose to do so, you may delete your entire account in Settings. We retain information for as long as necessary to provide the Platform and for the other purposes set out in this Privacy Policy.
concerns: Some data kept after account deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: TikTok states that your continued use of the Platform after a privacy policy update constitutes acceptance of the new policy.
categories.detail: Updates are posted with a new 'Last Updated' date. Continued access or use after the updated date constitutes acceptance. No explicit opt-out mechanism is described beyond stopping use.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your continued access to or use of the Platform after the date of the updated policy constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.
